title: Saved Chat Memory Handoff QA
principle: A useful saved chat should become reusable memory or knowledge with one local, reviewable action.
public_repo_rule: Promotion evidence is metadata only. It contains no prompts, responses, tokens, provider keys, pairing codes, billing data or private telemetry.

scenarios.expected: Conversation handoff can create a local memory item with review notes, tags and disabled backend sync by default.
Conversation handoff can create a local knowledge document in the Saved chats collection.
Each promotion writes a metadata-only receipt with target, item id and conversation id.
Memory and Knowledge panels refresh when local promotion events fire.
